name: unpad_draft_extend_output
description: Remove per-request draft padding and concatenate sequences. raw_out is [bs, T, H, D], cu_seqlens_q is an int32 [bs+1] prefix sum, seq_lens_q is an int32 [bs] vector, and sum_seq_lens_q is the total valid token count. For each request b, copy raw_out[b, :seq_lens_q[b]] to out[cu_seqlens_q[b]:cu_seqlens_q[b]+seq_lens_q[b]]. Returns a newly allocated [sum_seq_lens_q, H, D] tensor and does not mutate inputs. Suites exercise bfloat16 raw_out.
